description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: branching pink coral, orange sea fan coral, round blue brain coral, giant clam shell with a pearl, red starfish, spiky purple sea urchin, clump of green kelp seaweed, small coconut palm with coconuts, white beach rock with barnacles, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
